atoms.text:
Emotions are complicated. Sometimes you feel a mixture of positive and negative feelings.

Let’s try to show feelings on a scale. The left side is for very negative feelings, and the right side for very positive feelings.

instruction.text: Read the situation and choose a point on the scale indicating how someone might feel.

hint.text: The left side of the line means very negative feelings and the right side very positive feelings.

atoms.a: Someone just created a new art project, and it turned out better than expected.
